cohort: Adult pregnant women with and without SLE who had hospitalizations recorded in the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) database
finding: While maternal mortality and overall pregnancy outcomes improved for both groups, the decrease in in-hospital maternal deaths was greater among women with SLE.
mod_finding: The percentage of patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) in all pregnancy-related, as well as delivery-related, admissions increased significantly.
